description: This file contains the implementation of the CurrencyDao interface, specifically the CurrencyDaoImpl class, which extends a generic DAO class and provides a method to list Currency entities from the database using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CurrencyDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CurrencyDao interface, providing the method to retrieve a list of currencies from the database.
